# SOP-P2-L2-04 - Shift handover - Ring Rolling line
Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-IH01, EQ-P2-L2-HT02, EQ-P2-L2-RR03

Preconditions
1. Incoming and outgoing operators are certified per QS-PROC-07.
2. Equipment EQ-P2-L2-IH01, EQ-P2-L2-HT02, EQ-P2-L2-RR03 have completed end-of-shift checks per SOP-P2-L2-01.
3. Critical spares and lubricants verified against ECN-2026-031.

PPE
1. Safety glasses, hearing protection, cut-resistant gloves, steel-toe footwear.
2. Respiratory protection where indicated by posted permits.

Shift Handover Steps
1. Outgoing operator briefs incoming operator at control station near EQ-P2-L2-IH01. Cover current process status, open nonconformances, and parts in progress.
2. Verify machine modes and interlocks with incoming operator. Confirm no active alarms on EQ-P2-L2-HT02 and EQ-P2-L2-RR03.
3. Review lubrication status. The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is CFW-LUB-376. The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03) is CFW-LUB-101.
4. Confirm tooling and die change status; note any deviations and reference ECN-2026-031 for approved deviations.
5. Review last quality hold and inspection results per QS-PROC-07 and SOP-P2-L2-01. Record any pending inspections.
6. Transfer control of line logs and electronic entries. Outgoing operator initials physical log and completes electronic log entry.
7. Incoming operator repeats critical items back to outgoing operator and acknowledges understanding.

Sign-off
1. Outgoing operator name / signature / time.
2. Incoming operator name / signature / time.
3. Supervisor verification and signature referencing SOP-P2-L2-01 for completeness.

References
- ECN-2026-031
- QS-PROC-07
- SOP-P2-L2-01
